name.text: Secant-tangent - place A, then find PA (INNODEMS)

questiontext.text:
In the diagram, \(P\) is an external point, \(B\) and \(T\) lie on the circle, and \(PT\) is the tangent (so \(PT\) touches the circle at \(T\)). You are given that \(PT = {@ta_pt@}\text{ cm}\)

(a) Drag the red point \(A\) onto the circle so that \(P\), \(A\) and \(B\) lie on one straight line — that is, so that \(PAB\) is a secant. We have labelled \(BA\) with its length.

[[jsxgraph input-ref-ans1="refA" width="480px" height="430px"]] var PB = {#PB#}, PT = {#ta_pt#}; var rad = Math.PI / 180; var u = [Math.cos(150 * rad), Math.sin(150 * rad)]; var w = [Math.cos(212 * rad), Math.sin(212 * rad)]; var Pp = [0, 0]; var Bp = [PB * u[0], PB * u[1]]; var Tp = [PT * w[0], PT * w[1]]; function fixedCircle(P, T, B) { var dx = T[0] - P[0], dy = T[1] - P[1], L = Math.hypot(dx, dy); var nx = -dy / L, ny = dx / L; var tbx = T[0] - B[0], tby = T[1] - B[1]; var s = -(tbx * tbx + tby * tby) / (2 * (nx * tbx + ny * tby)); return [[T[0] + s * nx, T[1] + s * ny], Math.abs(s)]; } var fc = fixedCircle(Pp, Tp, Bp), ctr = fc[0], rr = fc[1]; var pad = 1.2; var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(divid, { boundingbox: [ctr[0] - rr - pad, ctr[1] + rr + pad, Math.max(ctr[0] + rr, 0) + pad + 0.6, ctr[1] - rr - pad], keepaspectratio: true, axis: false, showCopyright: false, showNavigation: false }); var circle = board.create('circle', [ctr, rr], {strokeColor: '#178a8a', strokeWidth: 1.5, fixed: true}); var P = board.create('point', Pp, {name: 'P', size: 2, fixed: true, fillColor: '#333', strokeColor: '#333', label: {offset: [10, 0], anchorX: 'left', anchorY: 'middle'}}); var B = board.create('point', Bp, {name: 'B', size: 2, fixed: true, fillColor: '#333', strokeColor: '#333', label: {offset: [-4, 12], anchorX: 'right', anchorY: 'bottom'}}); var T = board.create('point', Tp, {name: 'T', size: 2, fixed: true, fillColor: '#333', strokeColor: '#333', label: {offset: [-4, -12], anchorX: 'right', anchorY: 'top'}}); board.create('segment', [P, T], {strokeColor: '#333', strokeWidth: 1.5, fixed: true}); var A = board.create('glider', [ctr[0], ctr[1] + rr, circle], {name: 'A', size: 4, fillColor: '#d32f2f', strokeColor: '#d32f2f', label: {offset: [8, 8]}}); board.create('segment', [P, A], {strokeColor: '#1565c0', strokeWidth: 2}); board.create('segment', [A, B], {strokeColor: '#1565c0', strokeWidth: 2}); /* AP labelled as the unknown x (follows the glider) */ board.create('text', [ function () { return (P.X() + A.X()) / 2 - 0.3; }, function () { return (P.Y() + A.Y()) / 2 + 0.5; }, 'x' ], {anchorX: 'middle', anchorY: 'middle', fontSize: 15, fixed: true, cssStyle: 'color:#1565c0'}); /* AB labelled with its LIVE length (updates as A is dragged) */ board.create('text', [ function () { return (A.X() + B.X()) / 2 - 0.3; }, function () { return (A.Y() + B.Y()) / 2 + 1; }, function () { return A.Dist(B).toFixed(1) + ' cm'; } ], {anchorX: 'middle', anchorY: 'middle', fontSize: 13, fixed: true, cssStyle: 'color:#1565c0'}); /* PT (given) on the tangent */ board.create('text', [ (Pp[0] + Tp[0]) / 2 + 0.4, (Pp[1] + Tp[1]) / 2, PT + ' cm' ], {anchorX: 'left', anchorY: 'middle', fontSize: 13, fixed: true, cssStyle: 'color:#333'}); stack_jxg.bind_point(refA, A); [[/jsxgraph]]
[[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]]
[[feedback:prt1]]

(b) Hence use the diagram to find the length \(PA\) (marked \(x\)):

\( PA = \) [[input:ans2]]\(\text{ cm}\) [[validation:ans2]] [[feedback:prt2]]

generalfeedback.text:
(a) The secant from \(P\) cuts the circle twice: at the far point \(B\) and at the near point \(A\). So \(A\) is the second crossing of the straight line \(PB\) with the circle.

(b) By the secant-tangent theorem \(PT^2 = PA\cdot PB\), and \(PB = PA + AB\), so

\[ PA\,(PA + {@AB@}) = {@ta_pt@}^2 = {@PA*PB@}. \]

This gives \(PA^2 + {@AB@}\,PA - {@PA*PB@} = 0\), whose positive root is

\[ PA = \frac{-{@AB@} + \sqrt{{@AB@}^2 + 4\cdot{@PA*PB@}}}{2} = {@ta_pa@}\text{ cm}. \]

node.description: A placed at the correct near point.

truefeedback.text: Good — \(A\) is correctly placed: \(P\), \(A\) and \(B\) are now in a straight line.

node.description: A dropped onto B instead of the near point.

truefeedback.text: That is the point \(B\) itself. The secant cuts the circle twice — drag \(A\) to the other crossing, the one nearer to \(P\).

falsefeedback.text: Not quite. \(A\) should sit on the straight line through \(P\) and \(B\) — the nearer of the two places where that line crosses the circle. Drag \(A\) until \(P\), \(A\), \(B\) are in line.

node.description: Used PT^2 = PA*AB (chord) instead of PA*PB.

truefeedback.text: It looks like you used \(PT^2 = PA\cdot AB\). The theorem uses the whole secant \(PB\), not the chord \(AB\): \(PT^2 = PA\cdot PB\) with \(PB = PA + AB\). That gives a quadratic in \(PA\). Try again.

node.description: Gave the tangent length PT instead of PA.

truefeedback.text: That is \(PT\), the tangent length. You need \(PA\), the near part of the secant. Use \(PT^2 = PA\cdot PB\) and solve for \(PA\). Try again.

falsefeedback.text: Not correct. Set up \(PT^2 = PA\cdot PB\) with \(PB = PA + AB\); this is a quadratic in \(PA\). Solve it and take the positive root. Have another go.

qtest.description: A dropped on B; (b) used AB not PB
